statement: For the frozen map collatzStep n = (if Even n then n/2 else 3n+1): (a) prove in Lean, sorry-free, that [for all n>1 there is k>0 with collatzStep^[k] n < n] is EQUIVALENT to the Collatz conjecture [for all n>0 there is m with collatzStep^[m] n = 1]; (b) prove, uniformly in j and hence as universal theorems, the exact affine identities collatzStep^[1](2j)=j, collatzStep^[3](4j+1)=3j+1, collatzStep^[6](16j+3)=9j+2, collatzStep^[8](32j+11)=27j+10, collatzStep^[8](32j+23)=27j+20; (c) conclude that the descent hypothesis is needed only on n mod 32 in {7,15,27,31}.
